data.long_meaning: Niyati is a Sanskrit name that comes from the root word 'Ni' which means direction or decision. In Hindu mythology, Niyati is considered the goddess of justice and righteousness. She is the embodiment of fairness and impartiality, ensuring that every soul is treated justly in life and in death. The name Niyati carries the meaning “Direction, Decision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niyati usually hope their child will grow to embody direction, decision and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niyati total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
